results.title: Floor & Decor is rated "Average" with 2.8 / 5 on Trustpilot
results.content:
Considering 72 reviews, most reviewers were somewhat happy with their experience overall. Customers frequently mention that the staff is very helpful, friendly, and knowledgeable when guiding them through product choices in the showroom. Many consumers appreciate the personalized design assistance, great recommendations, and professional support received during their visits. Some reviewers were n ot happy with product defects and difficult issues regarding returns and unhelpful customer service responses. People reported major difficulties with damaged items, extremely slow service, and strict store policies that make resolving problems very frustrating. Several buyers also noted that getting appropriate support or refunds when things go wrong requires too much effort.See more [...] Unfortunately, our second interaction with Brian was just as frustrating. We later needed two additional risers totaling approximately $32. We asked if the $35 delivery charge could be waived, particularly considering how much we had already spent with the store. Brian refused and told us that he could not waive the fee. This was especially frustrating because another employee had waived a similar charge for us the previous week. [...] I attempted to resolve the problem directly with the merchant, but I was not satisfied with the resolution. I therefore filed a dispute with my credit card company for $5,501.79, which is the pre-tax amount I paid for the 71 boxes.  
  
What is especially frustrating is that Floor & Decor told my bank that the flooring was “Final Sale.” This is not true based on the evidence I have.  
  
I have a photograph that was taken at the time we purchased the flooring. The photo shows the exact same NuCore Pacific Dunes, SKU #101317139, and the price label clearly does not say “Final Sale,” “Final Sale – No Returns,” or “Sold As Is.”  
  
I also have the original receipt showing that I purchased 71 boxes for $5,501.79 before tax, as well as photographs documenting the defects.
